title: Smoky Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African stew originating from Algeria, made with tender lamb and aromatic spices. This dish is typically slow-cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid, but can also be cooked in a Dutch oven or a slow cooker.
instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a clay tagine or a Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, Algerian spice blend, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add 1 cup of water to the tagine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the tagine and transfer it to the oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
